title: Where a turn's trace id reaches ratings: three agent-server paths plus the wire tap
answers: which paths carry the turn trace id to slack ratings
where is turn-complete traceId added before the session log
how does agent-design stream get traceId for a turn
body:
A rating can arrive by three paths, and each needs the turn trace id:
- The command result the Slack relay reads, and the direct relay. Both go through `AgentServer.turnTraceId(result)` → `broadcastTurnComplete(stopReason, traceId)`, which appears at three prompt-handling call sites in agent-server.ts.
- The turn-complete ACP notification read by the agent-design stream. adapters/acp-connection.ts:installWireTaps applies `withTurnTraceId(message, config.stampedRunTraceId)` to it.
In installWireTaps, the stamp is applied before `logWriter.appendNotification`, because a thread reload reads the stored copy rather than the broadcast one. Any new enrichment of wire messages must also happen before the log write.
`withTurnTraceId` only touches `POSTHOG_NOTIFICATIONS.TURN_COMPLETE` messages that have object params and no string `traceId`. It returns the same object in every other case. `stampedRunTraceId` is passed to the connection through `AcpConnectionConfig.stampedRunTraceId`.
